identity.name: Endless Flight Spool
identity.summary: An ivory spool wrapped with a feather shaped bronze ribbon.
identity.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 2 arrows, 4 damage to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
identity.lore: The first arrow returned carrying the last feather ever shed.

effects.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 2 arrows, 4 damage to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Pairs with the permanent Bowmaster quiver and other different quiver attachments; normal bows receive no implicit bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Cinder Nock Rack, Scorpion Magazine, Seamfinder Lens, Winterflight Rack into Endless Flight Spool.

visual.brief: An ivory spool wrapped with a feather shaped bronze ribbon.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: An ivory spool wrapped with a feather shaped bronze ribbon.
